components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-priority Fluent UI action using the Evergreen brand color.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-medium); background: var(--colorBrandBackground); color: var(--colorNeutralForegroundOnBrand); font: 600 var(--font-size-300)/1.4 var(--font-family-base); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--duration-fast) ease; } .ds-primary-button:hover { background: var(--colorBrandBackgroundHover); } .ds-primary-button:active { background: var(--colorBrandBackgroundPressed); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colorBrandForeground1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Subtle Button
components.description: Low-emphasis secondary action used for header and list controls.
components.css: .ds-subtle-button { width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); border-radius: var(--radius-medium); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); color: var(--colorNeutralForegroundOnBrand); font: 400 var(--font-size-200)/1 var(--font-family-base); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--duration-fast) ease; } .ds-subtle-button:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); } .ds-subtle-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colorNeutralForegroundOnBrand); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: URI Search Input
components.description: Search field for finding an application by its download URL.
components.css: .ds-uri-search { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--colorNeutralForeground2); font: 600 var(--font-size-200)/1.4 var(--font-family-base); } .ds-uri-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--colorNeutralStroke2); border-radius: var(--radius-medium); background: var(--colorNeutralBackground1); color: var(--colorNeutralForeground1); font: 400 var(--font-size-300)/1.4 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-uri-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colorBrandForeground1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-uri-search input::placeholder { color: var(--colorNeutralForeground3); }

components.name: Recent Filter Toggles
components.description: Compact Fluent UI toggle buttons for filtering the application list by update age.
components.css: .ds-filter-toggles { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-filter-toggles button { min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--colorNeutralStroke2); border-radius: var(--radius-medium); background: var(--colorNeutralBackground1); color: var(--colorNeutralForeground1); font: 600 var(--font-size-200)/1.4 var(--font-family-base); cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-toggles button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--colorBrandBackground); background: var(--colorBrandBackground); color: var(--colorNeutralForegroundOnBrand); } .ds-filter-toggles button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colorBrandForeground1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Main Navigation Tabs
components.description: Fluent UI transparent tabs sit on the neutral navigation strip.
components.css: .ds-main-nav { padding: 0 12px; background: var(--colorNeutralBackground2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--colorNeutralStroke2); } .ds-main-nav [role="tablist"] { display: flex; gap: 4px; min-height: 44px; align-items: stretch; } .ds-main-nav [role="tab"] { padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--colorNeutralForeground2); font: 600 var(--font-size-300)/1.4 var(--font-family-base); cursor: pointer; } .ds-main-nav [role="tab"][aria-selected="true"] { border-bottom-color: var(--colorBrandBackground); color: var(--colorBrandForeground1); } .ds-main-nav [role="tab"]:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--colorBrandForeground1); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Application List Item
components.description: Sidebar option with a filled brand active state and a separate pin action.
components.html: • 7-Zip
components.css: .ds-app-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-app-option { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; margin: 1px 6px; padding: 7px 12px 7px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-large); color: var(--colorNeutralForeground1); font: 400 13px/1.4 var(--font-family-base); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--duration-fast) ease; } .ds-app-option:hover { background: var(--colorBrandBackground2); } .ds-app-option[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--colorBrandBackground); color: var(--colorNeutralForegroundOnBrand); font-weight: 600; } .ds-app-option__badge { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--colorBrandBackground); } .ds-app-option[aria-selected="true"] .ds-app-option__badge { background: var(--colorNeutralForegroundOnBrand); } .ds-app-option button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-app-option button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; } .ds-app-option button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Version Table
components.description: Dense, horizontally scrollable version data with quiet dividers and row hover feedback.
components.css: .ds-version-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--colorNeutralStroke2); border-radius: var(--radius-large); } .ds-version-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--colorNeutralForeground1); font: 400 var(--font-size-200)/1.4 var(--font-family-base); } .ds-version-table th { padding: 8px 12px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--colorNeutralStroke2); background: var(--colorNeutralBackground2); color: var(--colorNeutralForeground2); font-size: var(--font-size-300); font-weight: 600; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-version-table td { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--colorNeutralStroke2); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-version-table tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--colorNeutralBackground1Hover); }

components.name: Dashboard Stat Card
components.description: Fluent UI card pairs a prominent brand-colored metric with its compact label.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-large); background: var(--colorNeutralBackground1); color: var(--colorNeutralForeground1); font-family: var(--font-family-base); } .ds-stat-card strong { color: var(--colorBrandForeground1); font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-stat-card span { font-size: var(--font-size-200); font-weight: 600; } .ds-stat-card small { color: var(--colorNeutralForeground3); font-size: var(--font-size-100); }

narrative.overview: The Evergreen Workbench is a clean, modern admin dashboard designed for IT professionals who need to trust, find, and act on application version data quickly. The visual system prioritizes clarity and confidence: a neutral, minimal foundation that stays out of the way, paired with the Evergreen green as a vibrant, forward-facing signature color that commands attention for critical actions and brand presence. Every element is purposeful; nothing is decorative. The interface feels contemporary and professional—familiar enough for admins to navigate intuitively, distinctive enough to feel like a premium tool in their workflow.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral foundation with high contrast for readability in both light and dark contexts
Vibrant green accent used strategically on primary actions, navigation, and brand touchpoints
Generous whitespace and rhythm that balances density with breathability
Accessible by default with keyboard-first navigation and high contrast ratios
Flat, contemporary form language with minimal shadows (used only for elevation on mobile)
Fluent UI component library as the structural baseline, customized for Evergreen brand

rules.name: The Green Discipline Rule
rules.body: The Evergreen green is a signature color—used on ≤15% of most screens. Its rarity and vibrance make primary actions unmistakable and brand presence immediate. Overuse dilutes impact; restraint earns recognition.

rules.name: The Neutral Majority Rule
rules.body: 80%+ of screens are neutral (white, gray, text). This restraint makes the green pop and keeps the interface professional and focused on content, not decoration.

rules.name: The 14px Body Rule
rules.body: Body text is always 14px in light mode, never smaller. Screen-based reading requires legibility; 12px body is reserved for labels and helper text only. This ensures comfortable reading at typical admin workstations.

rules.name: The 600 Weight Rule
rules.body: Bold/heavy text is always 600 (semibold), never 700 (bold). The extra weight difference is subtle but modern; 600 reads as confident without aggression.

rules.name: The Slight-Radius Rule
rules.body: Corners are never sharp (0px) and never aggressively rounded (16px+). 2–8px keeps the interface contemporary, sharp, and professional.

dos: Do use the green (#009485) on primary actions only. Button clicks, active navigation, brand presence. Every instance of green should feel intentional and important.
Do maintain high contrast. Text on background must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body text). Test in both light and dark mode.
Do use 14px body text. Never go below 14px for on-screen reading, even on mobile. Labels and helpers can be 12px.
Do pair green with white. Green text on white background, or white text on green background. Never green on gray or green on green.
Do make interactive elements obvious. Button hover states must change (color, background, or subtle lift). Invisible states frustrate admins.
Do keep padding and spacing generous. 8px minimum between unrelated elements. Admins need room to click accurately, especially on touch devices.
Do organize tables by density, not decoration. Subtle alternating rows (white / light gray), light borders, align text left for easy scanning.
Do use keyboard shortcuts. Every navigation and action must be accessible by keyboard. Shortcuts (/, f, ?) are listed and always discoverable.
Do respect dark mode. All colors must invert intelligently. Test both themes equally; they're equally valid.
Do use motion conservatively. 150ms–200ms transitions on hover/focus. No decorative animations. Motion is feedback, not flourish.
donts: Don't use green as a neutral fill. Backgrounds, containers, and cards are always white/gray, never tinted green.
Don't use drop shadows on desktop. Flat, tonal layering only. Shadows are reserved for mobile overlays.
Don't mix rounded corners. Use the radius scale (xs/sm/md/lg) consistently within a component family. Random radii look accidental.
Don't nest too many grays. The palette is intentionally limited (3–4 distinct backgrounds). More grays muddy hierarchy.
Don't use color to convey information alone. Status or importance must be supported by text labels or icons, not just color.
Don't override focus rings. All interactive elements must have a visible keyboard focus indicator. Don't hide it for aesthetics.
Don't use decorative typefaces or serifs. Segoe UI only. No Georgia, no custom fonts. Professional, familiar, efficient.
Don't add unnecessary icons. Icons clarify action, not decorate. Every icon should be immediately clear; if users need a label anyway, the icon didn't help.
Don't use animations for state changes in tables. Sorting, filtering, and column swaps should be instant. Animation here feels slow and defensive.
Don't let content overflow containers. Truncate long text with ellipsis (...) or wrap thoughtfully. Overflow breaks the layout's integrity.
